fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Closes on a wounded quarry with a spear of arcana that deals 22 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Flushing Flare
fusions.desc: Sends a flare of arcana that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Predator's Focus
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, you deal 12% more damage.
